answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable deposit that stays locked while it transacts, like an opal held in escrow: creating one identity is cheap, but spawning a lagoon of fake identities multiplies the locked capital, so a sybil swarm must tie up real funds it cannot spend elsewhere. Honest agents earn the deposit back plus reputation, while detected duplicates forfeit it. The cost scales with the attack, not with honest use, so a small oasis of verified agents stays cheaper to run than a flood of fakes.
